title: Complete {platform} verification
defaultMessage: The platform blocked the request for now. Please verify once yourself

open.title: Open the verification page
open.desc: Open it in a browser {account}. If you're not logged in, log in in a new tab first.
open.account: logged in to the same {platform} account

solve.title: Follow the prompts on the page
solve.desc: Slider, image selection or SMS code. Once it says verified, you can close that tab.

back.title: Come back and retry
back.desc: Verification can take a few seconds to apply. If you're still blocked, wait a bit and try again, without retrying too often.

noLink: {platform} didn't provide a verification link. Open the {platform} website in your browser and follow the prompts, or try again in a few minutes.
